title: Removal of lead phosphate nanoparticles from drinking water by hydrogen peroxide photolysis combined with point-of-use filtration
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EW00248J, Communication
Cheng Tan, Haizhou Liu
The U.S. EPA recently lowered the lead action level to 10 μg L−1; however, lead phosphate nanoparticles are poorly removed by conventional filters, posing challenges for compliance.
